claims.text: Riot cut partner teams per region from 10 to 8 for the new format
EMEA partners: BBL Esports, Fnatic, FUT Esports, Gentle Mates, Karmine Corp, Team Heretics, Team Liquid, Team Vitality; no Arab team (BBL and FUT are Turkish)
Cloud9, KOI and Pacific champions Global Esports left out
Partners get automatic invites to VCT Kickoff 2027; $100k support packages for EMEA qualifier teams
Fnatic and G2 posted their own selection
